def f(G):
    H=len(G);W=len(G[0]);O=[row[:] for row in G]
    comps_=comps8(G)
    draws=[]
    for c in comps_:
        rs=[p[0] for p in c];cs_=[p[1] for p in c]
        cr=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2;cc=(min(cs_)+max(cs_))//2
        vals=Counter(G[p[0]][p[1]] for p in c);major=max(vals,key=vals.get)
        cent=G[cr][cc]
        if cent==0 or cent==major: continue
        draws.append((cr,cc,G[cr][cc],frozenset(c)))
    # verticals first, then horizontals override
    for cr,cc,col,c in draws:
        for k in range(H): O[k][cc]=col
    for cr,cc,col,c in draws:
        for j in range(W):
            if (cr,j) in c: continue
            O[cr][j]=col
    return O

def f(G):
    H=len(G);W=len(G[0]);O=[row[:] for row in G]
    draws=[]
    for c in comps8(G):
        rs=[p[0] for p in c];cs_=[p[1] for p in c]
        cr=(min(rs)+max(rs))//2;cc=(min(cs_)+max(cs_))//2
        vals=Counter(G[p[0]][p[1]] for p in c);major=max(vals,key=vals.get)
        cent=G[cr][cc]
        if cent==0 or cent==major: continue
        draws.append((cr,cc,G[cr][cc],frozenset(c)))
    # horizontal rays: paint bg only; stop before first foreign non-bg cell (excluding own shape cells)
    for cr,cc,col,c in draws:
        for d in (-1,1):
            j=cc+d;stopped=False
            while 0<=j<W and not stopped:
                if (cr,j) in c: j+=d;continue
                v=G[cr][j]
                if v!=0: stopped=True;break
                O[cr][j]=col; j+=d
    # verticals: paint bg only, last (overwrite horizontals)
    for cr,cc,col,c in draws:
        for k in range(H):
            if O[k][cc]==0: O[k][cc]=col
    return O
print('d1:',f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print('d2:',f(G['Demo pair 2 input'])==G['Demo pair 2 output'])
